provenance.rule: synchronize when trust is low, beam switch when it is medium, increase the prediction horizon when it is high (candidate b1)
provenance.data_source: Aegis-V2X live-drive browser simulation (Logapriya05/aegis-v2x-live-drive), not CARLA or real vehicles
provenance.objective: lowest J (configs/model.yaml objective_function) among candidate tables whose twin correctness is at least the fixed baseline's (horizon 5, sync every 1 s), overall and in every condition
provenance.selection: closed-loop runs with the mmWave beam model (configs/model.yaml twintrust_ap.beam) and joint beam adaptation, 8 conditions x 90 s, separate selection seeds; no candidate met the constraint; b1 had the lowest J and the highest accuracy of the beam-aware tables
provenance.test_result: evaluation seeds, 8 conditions x 150 s: J 0.090 vs 0.128 fixed (95% CI of difference -0.057..-0.018); twin correct 51.2% vs 54.7%; synchronisation 48.7 vs 45.8 per second
